{{recipe}}

This recipe for '''pastitsio''' has been improved on over the generations. The reason why this is cooked on the stove top & only browned in the oven is that in Greek villages there was a shared village oven. So dishes like these were popular as they could be browned after the bread had been baked.

==Ingredients==

=== Meat sauce ===
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 2 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 750 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] minced [[Cookbook:Meat and Poultry|meat]]
* 400–450 g canned chopped [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Tomato Paste|tomato paste]]
* ½ cup water
* ¼ cup dry white [[Cookbook:Wine|wine]]
* 1 tablespoon beef [[Cookbook:Stock Cube|stock powder]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]] powder
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]], beaten lightly

=== Greek-style bechamel sauce ===
* 100 g [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|plain flour]]
* 3½ cups [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Grating|grated]] fresh [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]] yolks

===Pasta mix===
* 250 g macaroni [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]] (or Greek pastitsio noodles)
* 2 eggs, beaten lightly
* ¾ cup grated fresh Parmesan or [[Cookbook:Feta Cheese|Feta cheese]]

=== Assembly ===

* 2 tablespoons stale [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|breadcrumbs]]

== Equipment ==
* 2.5-litre (10-cup) [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] (metal, glass or ceramic are fine)
* 2 large saucepans for meat sauce and pasta
* 1 medium-to-large saucepan for Bechamel sauce

== Procedure ==

=== Meat sauce ===
# Heat olive oil in pan. Add the chopped onions and [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] until translucent.
# Add the minced meat, and cook until well browned.
# Add the chopped canned tomatoes, liquid and all.
# Add the tomato paste, water, wine, beef stock powder, and cinnamon powder. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] uncovered until it becomes thick in consistency.
# Once thick transfer into a mixing bowl to cool.
# Once cool, stir in egg.

=== Greek-style Bechamel sauce === 
# Melt the butter in pan.
# Add the flour, and stir well over heat until bubbling.
# Remove pan from heat, and gradually add the milk. The mixture will become thick and will then thin again.
# Return pan to heat, and cook until sauce bubbles then thickens.
# Stir in Parmesan cheese until melted and smooth.
# Transfer to mixing bowl and cool slightly.
# Mix in the egg yolks.

=== Pasta mix === 
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the pasta as per directions on packet until tender.
# Drain pasta, and transfer to mixing bowl.
# Mix the hot pasta with the Parmesan cheese and eggs.

=== Assembly === 
# Grease baking dish.
# Press pasta mix into base of pan.
# Top pasta mix with the meat sauce.
# Pour the Bechamel sauce over the meat sauce, then smooth the top.
# Sprinkle the breadcrumbs over the top.
# In a preheated [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]], [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] at 180°C (350°F) for 1 hour until golden brown.
# Let rest for at least 10 minutes before serving.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* To avoid a large clean up at the end, just reuse the same saucepan.
* Leftovers freeze well, so it is a great freezer cooking dish.
* It is a good idea to start your meat sauce first as this needs to cool before you can begin construction.
* If desired, try adding a pinch of fresh grated [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]] to the bechamel sauce.
